title: Resend API key (re_): one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: prefix: RE_ vs the re_ the provider CLI requires and prefix: a whsec_ webhook signing secret, another credential class. Twin of "Resend API key (re_): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of resend-api-key-mcp-env: prefix: a whsec_ webhook signing secret, another credential class. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
